thermal_hazard._comment: Thermal (heat/humidity) is a SEPARATE hazard axis from precipitation. Precipitation severity comes from the IMD rendered warning map (WMS, palette-validated). Thermal comes from IMD's per-city 7-day forecast page, which carries warning PROSE ONLY -- no colour. So thermal level is always null and the literal IMD text is reported. An unmonitored district is never assumed Green.
thermal_hazard.station_ids_verified_against: IMD city page title + RMC transmission log (city.imd.gov.in/dashboard/transmet)
thermal_hazard.not_monitored_note: Thane, Navi Mumbai (Raigad) and Kolhapur have no IMD city-forecast station. They are reported NOT MONITORED, never Green.
thermal_hazard.image_index_note: IMD's warning_images/N.png is a set of decorative sky-condition illustrations (mixed sizes 391x340 to 278x283, colours green/white/cream/blue -- no red or orange). It is NOT a severity scale and is deliberately not read.
